1. **Diagnosed the issue** — checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy across all regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
